text: Seed-Head Meadow: a tray of live millet and canary grass grown to seed; the bird stands in it and strips seed heads like a wild flock on grassland
Summon Cord: a perch-side pull lever on a stainless bead chain, run through rigid tubing outside the cage, that rings a bell beside the owner across the room, so the bird can call its flock on demand
Call Button Board: a wooden pedal wired to a speaker outside the cage that plays the owner's recorded hello
violates: no electronics the bird can chew into

text: UV Charms: toy parts finished in bird-safe UV-reflective pigment, vivid to a tetrachromat budgie, plain to people
Drop Chute: the bird drops a light ball into a funnel at head height; it rattles down a chime spiral into a cup at foot level on the same perch, ready for the next drop
Budgie Piano: a row of wooden keys, each striking a differently tuned stainless chime when stepped on or pecked
Echo Tube: a curved bamboo resonator the bird chatters into and hears itself amplified
Answering Box: a speaker outside the cage that answers the bird's contact calls with real budgie flock calls
Window Watch: a perch at a window with a wild-bird feeder outside the glass
Lazy Susan Perch: a turntable platform the bird spins by walking along its rim
Flight Hoop Course: hoops hung across the room that the bird flies through on recall
Rustle Room: a big plain paper bag on a play tray for walking into, rustling, and hiding
Chime Gate: a curtain of stainless chime tubes across a play-stand doorway that the bird pushes through
Pocket Jungle: a potted bird-safe herb or spider plant to clamber through and nibble
Lettuce Curtain: wet romaine leaves hung for leaf-bathing
Pull-Up Bucket: a tiny bucket on a cord the bird hauls up beak-over-foot for a treat
Paper Unspooler: a roll of plain register paper on a bar, pulled and shredded endlessly
Beak Top: a lightweight wooden spinning top spun on a tray
Tilt Maze: a stepped-on tilt tray that rolls a ball into a cup to release a seed
Ice Treat Cube: frozen herbs and millet that melt out over an hour
Salad Chandelier: hanging bunches of dandelion, basil, and kale
Seesaw Beam: a balance beam that tips as the bird walks to either end
Table Soccer: a playmat goal the bird pushes a ball into while the owner returns it
Budgie Mailbox: a little box where the owner leaves a seed-filled paper 'letter' daily
Snuggle Hut: a fleece hideaway pouch
violates: bird-safe materials: no loose threads or fibers

text: Bubble Chase: a bubble machine outside the cage
violates: bird-safe materials: no toxic finishes (detergent on feathers)

text: Zipper Pull: a mounted zipper to open and close
Budgie Skateboard: a mini board for trick training
Seed-Head Carousel: a mobile of seed heads that spins when landed on, so the bird hangs upside down to strip it
Toy Rotation Carousel: a six-slot rack the owner turns daily so something is always new
Shadow Wall: a lamp casting slow-moving leaf shadows on the cage wall
Flock Silhouette: budgie cutouts behind frosted acrylic
Rhythm Perch: a perch over an external speaker playing steady beats to bob along to
Finger Puppet: an owner-worn finger puppet for play sessions
Budgie Decoy: a plush lifelike budgie companion
violates: bird-safe materials: no loose threads or fibers

text: Surprise Box: a one-time sealed box of treats
Mini Hamster Wheel: a small exercise wheel
violates: sized for a budgie: no openings that trap head, toes, or legs

text: Rainstick Perch: a sealed bamboo perch with seeds inside that rattles as the bird walks or tips it
Flap Door: a light swinging flap into a side play box the bird learns to push through
Ledge Lookout: a high corner shelf with a view of the room
